statement: Let N include zero, and let I_k=Fin k={0,...,k-1}, with I_0 empty. Every vector below is a function I_k→R and is indexed from zero. Natural subtraction k-1 is truncated at zero; k in a real expression denotes its real cast. Empty sums are zero and empty products are one. Lean real division is total: 0 inverse=0 and x/0=0. Write E for entry, P_n for roundedProduct, S_n for sequentialDot, D_i for dotWeight, F for finalWeight, and Δ_i for perturbation, with their parameters as below. Both targets state componentwise backward error bounds for one scalar update with k≥2, 0≤u, ku<1 and b_{k-1}≠0. One uses each specified admissible error tuple and its explicit perturbation; the other asserts existence of a bounded perturbation for every result represented by some such tuple. This is a single algebraic update, not a specified full triangular matrix algorithm.

targets.name: TriangularUpdate.triangular_update_constructed
targets.statement: For every k∈N, hypothesis hk:2≤k, u∈R with 0≤u and ku<1, a,b:I_k→R, and c∈R, assume b_{k-1}≠0. The hypothesis hk supplies the positivity of k needed by lastIndex, computedValue and BackwardEquation. For every ξ,δ:I_k→R and η,ζ∈R satisfying LocalErrors(u,ξ,δ,η,ζ), let yhat=computedValue(hk_positive,a,b,ξ,δ,c,η,ζ) and let Δb be exactly perturbation(b,ξ,δ,η,ζ). Then both ∑_{i=0}^{k-2} a_i(b_i+Δb_i)+yhat(b_{k-1}+Δb_{k-1})=c and, for every i∈I_k, |Δb_i|≤[ku/(1-ku)]|b_i|. Explicitly Δb_i=b_i((1+ξ_i)∏_{j∈N:1≤j≤k-2, i≤j}(1+δ_j)-1) for i<k-1 and Δb_{k-1}=b_{k-1}(((1+η)(1+ζ))^{-1}-1). The weights expand the sequential dot computation, while the last weight cancels the combined final error factors in the exact equation.

targets.name: TriangularUpdate.triangular_update
targets.statement: For every k∈N, hypothesis hk:2≤k, u∈R with 0≤u and ku<1, a,b:I_k→R, and c∈R, assume b_{k-1}≠0. The hypothesis hk supplies the positivity of k needed by lastIndex, computedValue and BackwardEquation. For every yhat∈R satisfying IsEvaluation(hk_positive,u,a,b,c,yhat), there exists Δb:I_k→R such that ∑_{i=0}^{k-2} a_i(b_i+Δb_i)+yhat(b_{k-1}+Δb_{k-1})=c and, for every i∈I_k, |Δb_i|≤[ku/(1-ku)]|b_i|. The premise means that some bounded error tuple represents this very yhat by computedValue. Applying the explicit perturbation to those witnesses supplies the vector in the conclusion. The conclusion itself only asserts existence and does not assert uniqueness of Δb or of the error witnesses.

constructions.name: TriangularUpdate.gamma
constructions.description: For all k∈N and u∈R, gamma(k,u)=ku/(1-ku). The definition has no sign or nonzero-denominator restriction; total real division applies.

constructions.name: TriangularUpdate.entry
constructions.description: For implicit k∈N, v:I_k→R and n∈N, E(v,n)=v_n if n<k and 0 otherwise. It extends the vector by zero.

constructions.name: TriangularUpdate.lastIndex
constructions.description: For k∈N with a supplied hypothesis hk:0<k, lastIndex(k,hk) is the index k-1 in I_k; hk certifies that it is in range.

constructions.name: TriangularUpdate.roundedProduct
constructions.description: For implicit k∈N, a,b,ξ:I_k→R and n∈N, P_n=E(a,n)E(b,n)(1+E(ξ,n)). Thus it is a_n b_n(1+ξ_n) for n<k and zero otherwise. It is a real expression with a supplied error factor; no rounding operation is defined.

constructions.name: TriangularUpdate.sequentialDot
constructions.description: For implicit k∈N, a,b,ξ,δ:I_k→R and n∈N, S_0=0, S_1=P_0, and S_{m+1}=(S_m+P_m)(1+E(δ,m)) for every m≥1. The input n is unrestricted. The first product is assigned directly without an addition error δ_0; later steps multiply the entire updated sum by the supplied factor. Zero extension makes S_n constant for n≥k. The scalar update uses S_{k-1}, which for k≥2 uses just indices 0,...,k-2.

constructions.name: TriangularUpdate.computedValue
constructions.description: For implicit k∈N with hk:0<k, a,b,ξ,δ:I_k→R and c,η,ζ∈R, computedValue(hk,a,b,ξ,δ,c,η,ζ)=((c-S_{k-1})(1+η)/b_{k-1})(1+ζ). It computes a sequential dot sum of the first k-1 entries, subtracts it from c, multiplies by 1+η, divides by the final entry of b, then multiplies by 1+ζ. The definition itself does not require b_{k-1}≠0. No floating-point format or rounding rule is specified.

constructions.name: TriangularUpdate.LocalErrors
constructions.description: For implicit k∈N, u∈R, ξ,δ:I_k→R and η,ζ∈R, LocalErrors(u,ξ,δ,η,ζ) is the conjunction: for every i∈I_k with i<k-1, |ξ_i|≤u; for every i∈I_k with 1≤i<k-1, |δ_i|≤u; |η|≤u; and |ζ|≤u. There are no other bounds: in particular, when k>0 the last ξ entry and the first and last δ entries are not constrained by the index conditions.

constructions.name: TriangularUpdate.IsEvaluation
constructions.description: For implicit k∈N with hk:0<k, u∈R, a,b:I_k→R and c,yhat∈R, IsEvaluation(hk,u,a,b,c,yhat) means there exist ξ,δ:I_k→R and η,ζ∈R satisfying LocalErrors(u,ξ,δ,η,ζ) and yhat=computedValue(hk,a,b,ξ,δ,c,η,ζ). It expresses existence of an evaluation using the supplied real error-factor model.

constructions.name: TriangularUpdate.dotWeight
constructions.description: For implicit k∈N, ξ,δ:I_k→R and i∈I_k, D_i=(1+ξ_i) ∏_{j∈N: j<k-1, 1≤j, i≤j}(1+E(δ,j)). Every j in this product is in I_k, so E(δ,j)=δ_j. This definition also applies to i=k-1 for k>0, where the product is empty, although perturbation uses D_i only for i<k-1. For k≥2, expansion of the actual recurrence gives S_{k-1}=∑_{i=0}^{k-2} a_i b_i D_i.

constructions.name: TriangularUpdate.finalWeight
constructions.description: For η,ζ∈R, F=((1+η)(1+ζ))^{-1}. It is zero if the product vanishes. Under the theorem hypotheses its two factors are positive, so it is their ordinary reciprocal.

constructions.name: TriangularUpdate.perturbation
constructions.description: For implicit k∈N, b,ξ,δ:I_k→R, η,ζ∈R and i∈I_k, Δ_i=b_i(D_i-1) if i<k-1, and Δ_i=b_i(F-1) otherwise. For k>0 the otherwise case is exactly i=k-1; for k=0 the vector is empty. Hence b_i+Δ_i=b_i D_i on the first k-1 entries, while b_{k-1}+Δ_{k-1}=b_{k-1}F. This scales b by accumulated product/addition factors on the first entries and by the reciprocal final factors on the last. It changes neither a nor c.

constructions.name: TriangularUpdate.BackwardEquation
constructions.description: For implicit k∈N with hk:0<k, a,b,Δb:I_k→R and c,yhat∈R, BackwardEquation(hk,a,b,Δb,c,yhat) is ∑_{i∈I_k: i<k-1} a_i(b_i+Δb_i)+yhat(b_{k-1}+Δb_{k-1})=c. The last entry a_{k-1} is unused; the final perturbed b entry is multiplied by yhat.

assumptions: Let N include zero, and let I_k=Fin k={0,...,k-1}, with I_0 empty. Every vector below is a function I_k→R and is indexed from zero. Natural subtraction k-1 is truncated at zero; k in a real expression denotes its real cast. Empty sums are zero and empty products are one. Lean real division is total: 0 inverse=0 and x/0=0. Write E for entry, P_n for roundedProduct, S_n for sequentialDot, D_i for dotWeight, F for finalWeight, and Δ_i for perturbation, with their parameters as below.

Both targets universally quantify k∈N with 2≤k, u∈R with 0≤u and ku<1, a,b:I_k→R and c∈R, with b_{k-1}≠0. In particular 0≤u<1/k and 1-ku>0. No further restrictions are imposed on entries of a or b or on c.

The constructed target universally quantifies ξ,δ:I_k→R and η,ζ∈R subject exactly to LocalErrors. The existential target universally quantifies yhat∈R and assumes IsEvaluation, which existentially quantifies those same error parameters with exactly those bounds.

No machine arithmetic, rounding mode, representability, underflow, overflow, or additional matrix structure is assumed. All definitions have exactly the domains and hypotheses recorded in their descriptions.
